# Binary carrier with scalar contexts and exact array tails

Two independent Map<K,V> method formals retain their invariant carrier beside
closed String contexts, an original boolean word and a String[] tail. Both
convenience and explicit-array calls preserve fixed-arity varargs dispatch.
Four frozen routes compare 96 cases twice with source and SDK providers,
auditing every original entry and metadata attribute after compiling all output.
Observers check exact flags, map/array/context identity, partial mutations,
callback order, opaque result identity and exact failures. Six wrong programs
and Code-preserving Signature controls guard the proof. Native checks also
cover every primitive context width and complete wide register pairs.
Only authored fixtures execute.
